messages:
sarah (PM): Quick sync — we need to lock scope for the Optimize toolkit sprint next week. Customers keep pushing three asks: adaptive batching heuristics, quantization recommendation guidance in Console, and eval-triggered quality alerts. Proposing three scope options below. Need quick votes + major risks. @mike @sasha please weigh in.

mike (eng): Option A = narrow ship: heuristic engine + simple toggle UI to enable/disable adaptive batching per-route. Low-risk path, ETA ~4w. Main blocker: runtime routing changes to support per-request batching hints.

sasha (eng-ml): Quant recs need a profiling pipeline first. MVP = coarse recommendations (e.g., FP16 vs 4-bit) based on tokenization + perf profile; ~6w. Eval-triggered alerts require eval infra + label sets — more work, I'd treat as phase 2.

tara (data-science): From our bench, adaptive batching + prefix caching gave 2x-3x cost reduction on high-throughput seq gen workloads. Alerts are valuable only if we tie them to specific prompt sets and acceptance thresholds. Need SLI baseline before alerts.

linda (solutions): Field input: customers want a "recommendation-as-config" export (CSV/JSON) so they can prod-test locally. If heuristics ship with an export + example configs, adoption will be faster.

josh (product): My take: go hybrid — ship heuristics + quant recommendations as Phase 1 (MVP) and schedule eval-triggered alerts as Phase 2 gated by pilot. Keeps initial scope realistic and hits customer asks.

sarah (PM): Proposed acceptance criteria (Phase 1 MVP):
```
- Adaptive batching heuristics implemented and enabled per-route in Console.
- Console UI: enable/disable toggle, recommended batch size, exportable recommendation (CSV/JSON).
- Quant rec pipeline: per-model perf profile + recommendation (FP16/4-bit) surfaced in Console.
- End-to-end test showing >=20% token-cost reduction on at least one customer workload in pilot.
- Rollout plan with canary & automatic fallback to current routing on error.
```

emily (customer-success): We can recruit 3 pilot customers: AcmeCorp, NovaAI, LedgerX. We'll need a short runbook and a rollback checklist for each.

mike (eng): Engineering risk note: runtime routing change could increase p99 by ~20-30% during rollout windows. Proposed mitigation: canary traffic limited to <10% with immediate fallback to non-adaptive pool on error. Also need a metric to detect batching misfires.

sasha (eng-ml): For quant recs: we should store model profiles in a lightweight JSON schema and version them. Console should show "confidence" of a rec based on observed perf.

linda (solutions): I'll draft the export format and a customer-facing one-pager. Also recommend a checkbox in onboarding that enables pilot mode.

deploy-bot: Created epic OPT-2026 and subtask OPT-2026-1 (heuristics), OPT-2026-2 (quant-profiler), OPT-2026-3 (pilot runbook).

sarah (PM): Decision: hybrid path approved. Owners: Mike = runtime/rollout, Sasha = profiling & quant recs, Tara = metrics & eval definitions, Linda = pilot ops/docs. I'll draft the PRD this afternoon and push to the roadmap board. @everyone — add explicit blockers in this thread by EOD so we can finalize sprint planning. :thumbsup:
